book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel heki’walaŋ kwanai diniŋ kahat Lukdi youkuk

content: Pitadi Jesu wou foloŋ me niŋ kayoŋ kadakaniŋ tubukedebaguk
Heleniŋ Pita dut Jon adi 3 kilok tebele Bepaŋ ninadidok Siloŋyotneŋ fode ugumuk.
Wooŋ talik yeme wou Momooŋ, uŋoŋ wooŋ me niŋ kayoŋ kadakaniŋ kagumuk. Adi undiniŋgoŋ mintaguk doktiŋa helemahelemaŋ noliŋiyedi nagi wooŋ uŋgoŋ kameune metam noli buune muneeŋdok nayo ila tuluguk.
Ala Pita dut Jon ugumuk kaŋ yabuŋa nemek neeŋbe mindemek yo yeninadiguk.
Kaŋ meyat adi uŋgoŋ yaliŋa kahohoŋe tiŋa Pitadi indiŋ niŋguk, “I nibeŋ,”
kaŋ me u meyatdi nemek neeŋbe minde niyamuk yoŋa yabuguk.
Kaŋ Pitadigoŋ koti indiŋ niŋguk, “Nu muneeŋne nemoŋ, iŋgoŋ nemek niŋ kame hatilat uŋak gambit. Jesu Kilisto Nasaletniŋ adi wou foloŋ ganilat, pilali talik yaweŋ.”
Unduŋ niŋa kohoŋ didimeniŋdi honeune me u kayoŋ didimeune pilakadoŋa yali uŋambuŋat tuguk.
Unduŋ tiŋa wooŋ tatakula Bepaŋ niutumbaaŋ meyat dut Siloŋyotneŋ noŋgoŋ fogiŋ.
Foune metam uŋoŋ hakiŋ adi me kayoŋ kadakaniŋ u kakiyondaaŋ yogiŋ,
me i Yeme Momooŋ gineŋ ilaŋa bomboŋdok nayo tilak i detiŋa buŋa tatakula Bepaŋ niutumbalak, yoŋa boho tigiŋ.
Pitadi Siloŋyot gineŋ Jesu’walaŋ mebiŋiŋ yenindakaleguk
Unduŋ tulu me kayoŋ kadakaniŋ adi Siloŋyot walanda niŋ, Solomon diniŋ yoyagiŋneŋ, Pita dut Jon yohonekiliti tiŋa yatune metam adi boho tiŋa kiyaneeŋ Pita heki yakiŋneŋ uune
Pitadi indiŋ yeniŋguk. “Isilaehi metam, hidi maŋgoŋde nemek yendok boho tiŋa nibuhohoŋe tiiŋ. Indi inde’walaŋ titiŋ kedem be saŋiniŋnik foloŋ mu tide me i utumbalak.

Yadi Abalaham, Aisak, Jekop, eŋ papaniye adi’walaŋ Bepaŋdi tipilapilaye-meŋiŋ Jesu wou niŋa tiloloŋdok tubukedebaŋak. Iŋgoŋ hidi koom Jesu moŋ niŋa mikme heki kohohik foloŋ kameune nagi wooŋ mede gineŋ kamegiŋ. Kaŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ Me Uŋgoniŋ, me didimeniŋ i Pailatdi bikabudok yoguk iŋgoŋ hidi gigine tiŋa Pailat nimbune me kadakaniŋ titiŋ u bikabu uune
Hatihati Molom i ulukumuŋgiŋ. Iŋgoŋ mindaŋ Bepaŋdi kumuŋ gineniŋ tubukaikaguk, kaŋ kobuk indi folooŋ kaŋ nadisukilitimiŋa keleyam,
adi’walaŋ saŋiniŋ foloŋ tubukedebamut. Nemek i tide kaŋit adi nadisukilitinik Jesu’walaŋ hatak doktiŋa kwanai i tumut. Kaŋ Jesu wou foloŋ me i utumbaŋak.
“Unduŋ doktiŋa notniye, nu indiŋ hanimbit. Hidi talitimeŋhiye dut Jesu adi Bepaŋ’walaŋ Kilisto u mu nadidakaleeŋ ulukumuŋgiŋ.
U agaŋ koom Bepaŋdi polofet yenimbune Kilisto folofigita nadiwaakdok yotabugiŋ doktiŋa hidi unduŋ tigiŋ, kaŋ mede wondi undugoŋ mintaguk.
Ale hidi kadakaniŋhik sigilulum tiyemiŋa Bepaŋ’walaŋkade uune adi kadakaniŋhik tumolokuhambune welehik lodawek.
Unduŋ tubune Jesu, Bepaŋ ne hiditok Kilisto nindapmaguk, u kamehambu baak.
Ala adi kunum gineŋ uŋgoŋ hatitauyeeŋ koom Bepaŋ’walaŋ polofet hekidi yogiŋ unduŋ, naiŋiŋ foloŋ kotigoŋ buŋa nemenemek yehitubu-didimewaak.
“Koom Mosesdi indiŋ yoguk,

content.text: ‘Bepaŋ Wapumhikdi polofetŋiŋ nu napmeguk undiniŋgoŋ kamehambaak. Tiŋa polofet u hide’walaaniŋgoŋ me niŋ kamewaak, ala hidi adi’walaŋ mede hogohogok nadiŋa tiloloŋ taneeŋ.
Nebek niŋdi medeŋiŋ nadiŋa mu takaliluwaak adi Bepaŋdi widihikumuŋ tibaak.’

content: “Samuel tiŋa polofet noli mindaŋ kwanainegiŋ adi nemek kougoŋ mintawaak wendok yohautagiŋ kaŋ folooŋ kobuk mintalak.
Bepaŋdi polofetŋiye yofafaŋe mede yeniŋguk kaŋ hidi Bepaŋdi papahiye dut yofolok tuguk u hidi maaŋ hehihonelak. Abalaham niŋguk unduŋ,

content.text: ‘Du yalakige foloŋ metam hogohogok kwetfoloŋ hatiiŋ kahaŋ tiyembaat.’

content: “Unduŋ yoguk doktiŋa Bepaŋ adi kwanai-meŋiŋ kameune fooŋ kahaŋ hiditok timeŋ tihamuŋa kadakaniŋ gineniŋ hanagikuk.”
